understanding: Surviving being laughed at by strangers takes away the terror: the chains fall off and you are no longer afraid.
evidence: Once you realize in your bones that you can survive being laughed at by strangers, you stop living in terror of it.

claim.asserted: Surviving being laughed at by strangers makes you stop living in terror of it.
claim.speaker: narrator

before: You are afraid, chained by terror.
transformation: Strangers laugh and you survive it.
after: The terror is gone; you are calm.

camera.purpose: the laughter, the chains leaving, the calm person in one frame
